statements:
CREATE TABLE comunicados (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	titulo VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	destinatario VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	mensagem TEXT NOT NULL, 
	criado_por VARCHAR(120), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)


CREATE TABLE disciplinas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nome VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	codigo VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	carga_horaria INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (codigo)
)


CREATE TABLE turmas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nome VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	codigo VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	ano_letivo INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turno VARCHAR(30), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (codigo)
)


CREATE TABLE usuarios (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	senha VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	tipo VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (email)
)


CREATE TABLE alunos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	usuario_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nome VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	cpf VARCHAR(14), 
	matricula VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	curso_serie VARCHAR(80), 
	status_matricula VARCHAR(20), 
	foto_perfil VARCHAR(255), 
	data_nascimento DATE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (usuario_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(usuario_id) REFERENCES usuarios (id), 
	UNIQUE (cpf), 
	UNIQUE (matricula)
)


CREATE TABLE professores (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	usuario_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nome VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	cpf VARCHAR(14) NOT NULL, 
	telefone VARCHAR(20), 
	disciplina_principal VARCHAR(80), 
	formacao_academica VARCHAR(120), 
	regime_trabalho VARCHAR(50), 
	foto_perfil VARCHAR(255), 
	data_admissao DATE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (usuario_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(usuario_id) REFERENCES usuarios (id), 
	UNIQUE (cpf)
)


CREATE TABLE turmas_disciplinas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turma_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_turma_disciplina UNIQUE (turma_id, disciplina_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(turma_id) REFERENCES turmas (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE alunos_disciplinas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aluno_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_aluno_disciplina UNIQUE (aluno_id, disciplina_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aluno_id) REFERENCES alunos (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE alunos_turmas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aluno_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turma_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_aluno_turma UNIQUE (aluno_id, turma_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aluno_id) REFERENCES alunos (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(turma_id) REFERENCES turmas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE atividades (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turma_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	titulo VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	descricao TEXT, 
	data_entrega VARCHAR(10), 
	caminho_arquivo VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(turma_id) REFERENCES turmas (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE documentos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aluno_id INTEGER, 
	professor_id INTEGER, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	titulo VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	caminho_arquivo VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	data_envio TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aluno_id) REFERENCES alunos (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE notas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aluno_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nota DECIMAL(4, 2) NOT NULL, 
	observacao VARCHAR(255), 
	data_lancamento TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_nota_aluno_disciplina UNIQUE (aluno_id, disciplina_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aluno_id) REFERENCES alunos (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id)
)


CREATE TABLE professores_disciplinas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	disciplina_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_professor_disciplina UNIQUE (professor_id, disciplina_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(disciplina_id) REFERENCES disciplinas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE professores_turmas (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	professor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	turma_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_professor_turma UNIQUE (professor_id, turma_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(turma_id) REFERENCES turmas (id)
)


CREATE TABLE solicitacoes_documentos (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	aluno_id INTEGER, 
	professor_id INTEGER, 
	documento_id INTEGER, 
	titulo VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	mensagem TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(aluno_id) REFERENCES alunos (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(professor_id) REFERENCES professores (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(documento_id) REFERENCES documentos (id)
)
